author: DombNexen
description: Monitor the public 3DXChat status endpoint with one editable Discord message, optional presence, and state-change alerts.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only per-server configuration such as channel IDs, message IDs, and alert settings. It does not store member or user data.
install_msg: Use `[p]3dxstatus setup #channel` to create one editable status message. Use `[p]3dxstatus alerts true` for transition-only alerts and `[p]3dxstatus presence true` as the bot owner for presence updates.
